cases.name: issue1036_coincident_skins_difference
cases.note: #1036 (crates/solidcore/tests/issue_1036_coincident_skin_sides.rs): two capped degree-1 skins sharing three section curves (A through sections 0..4, B through 2..6), so their side faces coincide between z = 20 and z = 40. The port gives an empty A - B, all of A for A n B and fails A u B (1001) at c9c5979 and at v1.0.1; this case shows what the C++ gives.
